title: Nuer language
description: Nilotic language spoken in western Ethiopia and South Sudan
extract: The Nuer language is a Nilotic language of the Western Nilotic group. It is spoken by the Nuer people of South Sudan and in western Ethiopia. The language is very similar to Dinka and Atuot.
